title: New Jobs Monitor input
description: Monitor public job boards from Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, Recruitee, SmartRecruiters, Breezy HR, Personio, Workday and Rippling with ID-based history.

companies.title: Company boards
companies.description: Between 1 and 200 boards. Workday accepts a public HTTPS board URL or tenant/wdN/site. Other sources use board identifiers.

source.title: ATS
source.description: Applicant tracking system that hosts the board.

company.title: Board identifier
company.description: Workday: public HTTPS board URL on tenant.wdN.myworkdayjobs.com or tenant/wdN/site. Other sources: board identifiers. Source-specific validation runs before requests.

stateKey.title: State key
stateKey.description: demo never reads or saves history and returns current matching jobs on every run. Repeated demo runs may charge the same jobs again. Omitted or blank values use default with persistent history. Use other keys for independent lists.

firstRun.title: Initial run behavior
firstRun.description: For persistent keys: all returns existing matching jobs on the initial run; none records a baseline. Demo always uses all and never saves history.

keywords.title: Title keywords
keywords.description: Up to 50 case-insensitive title substrings. Any keyword may match. Empty means no title filter.

locations.title: Location keywords
locations.description: Up to 50 case-insensitive location substrings. Any location may match. Empty means no location filter.

maxNewJobs.title: Maximum new jobs per run
maxNewJobs.description: Maximum jobs saved to the dataset in one run. For persistent keys, jobs beyond this limit remain pending for a later run.

workdayMaxPages.title: Maximum Workday pages per company
workdayMaxPages.description: Each page contains up to 20 jobs. Default: 10 pages, up to 200 jobs per company. The per-company run report indicates truncation.
